stories.title: Adelanto de las elecciones generales, en directo | Mónica García se postula para liderar el Frente Amplio: “Estoy dispuesta a lo que sea necesario”

en.title: Early general elections announced, live | Mónica García positions herself to lead the Broad Front: "I am willing to do whatever is necessary"
en.summary: Spain's Prime Minister Sánchez announced early elections for November 29, acknowledging past errors and seeking broader support. Opposition leader Feijóo welcomed the announcement, while courts rejected a Madrid official's request to evict a protest camp.

stories.title: Rusia pone bajo observación a cientos de personas tras morir una investigadora de un laboratorio contra la peste

en.title: Russia places hundreds under observation after a plague laboratory researcher dies
en.summary: Several hospitals in Russia's Siberian Irkutsk region are under quarantine following the death of a laboratory researcher. Regional authorities are investigating what they describe as a particularly dangerous infection.

stories.title: Carlos Alcaraz - Jaume Munar, en directo | El murciano remonta el partido y jugará la final en Tokio

en.title: Carlos Alcaraz - Jaume Munar, live | The Murcia native comes from behind and will play the final in Tokyo
en.summary: Spanish tennis player Carlos Alcaraz defeated compatriot Jaume Munar in a semifinal match to advance to the final of the Tokyo ATP 500 tournament, which Alcaraz won the previous year.

stories.title: Premio Nobel Medicina 2026 a Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann y Georg Nagel por sus descubrimientos de la optogenética

en.title: 2026 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine awarded to Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann and Georg Nagel for their discoveries in optogenetics
en.summary: The Swedish Royal Academy of Sciences awarded the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine to three scientists for their discoveries regarding light-activated ion channels and optogenetics.

stories.title: Alcaraz tumba a Munar a base de golpes y jugará en Tokio su cuarta final del año

en.title: Alcaraz defeats Munar with powerful shots and will play his fourth final of the year in Tokyo
en.summary: Spanish tennis player Alcaraz recovered after losing the first set to defeat Munar 5-7, 6-3, 6-1 in a final match. He will compete in Tokyo seeking his third title of 2026.

stories.title: El Consejo de Ministros aprobará mañana unos decretos de vivienda similares a los que cayeron para que los vote la Diputación Permanente

en.title: The Council of Ministers will approve tomorrow housing decrees similar to those rejected so the Permanent Delegation votes on them
en.summary: With parliament dissolved, the government plans to resubmit housing decrees through the Permanent Delegation, where it does not require support from Junts to pass them.

stories.title: Elecciones generales, en directo: última hora del adelanto electoral de Pedro Sánchez y reacciones al 29 de noviembre

en.title: General elections live: latest news on Pedro Sánchez's early election call and reactions to November 29
en.summary: Spanish President Pedro Sánchez announced he will advance general elections to November 29 due to lack of parliamentary support for his government.

stories.title: Sánchez adelanta las elecciones al 29 de noviembre

en.title: Sánchez advances elections to November 29
en.summary: The Council of Ministers will reapprove housing decrees previously rejected by Congress, with the Permanent Delegation validating them without needing Junts support.

stories.title: Sánchez convoca elecciones generales el 29 de noviembre

en.title: Sánchez calls general elections for November 29
en.summary: Spanish President Pedro Sánchez has dissolved parliament and called early general elections for November 29. He informed King Felipe VI of the decision following consultations with socialist party officials and other political leaders.

stories.title: Sánchez adelanta las elecciones al 29 de noviembre: “Necesitamos una mayoría progresista mucho más amplia”

en.title: Sánchez advances elections to November 29: "We need a much broader progressive majority"
en.summary: President Sánchez has moved forward the general elections to November 29, citing the need for a broader progressive majority. He reviewed achievements of the left-wing coalition government.

stories.title: Pedro Sánchez adelanta las elecciones generales al 29 de noviembre

en.title: Pedro Sánchez advances general elections to November 29
en.summary: President Sánchez has ended the parliamentary term and called early elections for November 29 following the defeat of housing decrees and large-scale mobilizations.

stories.title: Flávio Bolsonaro gana a Lula, pero los dos disputarán una segunda vuelta en tres semanas

en.title: Flávio Bolsonaro defeats Lula, but both will compete in a second round in three weeks
en.summary: A strong conservative wave brings the far-right to power in São Paulo, Rio, and the Senate in Brazil's elections. A runoff between the two candidates will be held in three weeks.

stories.title: El Ibex, condicionado por el euro, la deuda y la política

en.title: The Ibex, conditioned by the euro, debt and politics
en.summary: The euro has fallen to 17-month lows amid concerns about sovereign debt, particularly France's. The Spanish Ibex index is monitoring European market uncertainties and Brazil's election results.

stories.title: Barclays roza la valoración récord de Repsol

en.title: Barclays approaches Repsol's record valuation
en.summary: Barclays has raised its price target for Repsol to near the highest valuation assigned by analysts covering the stock, despite recent oil price moderation.

stories.title: Los valores del Ibex más alcistas por el 'efecto Brasil'

en.title: Ibex stocks rise most in Europe on 'Brazil effect'
en.summary: The Ibex index leads European indices as Spanish companies with significant Brazilian market exposure gain following the first round of Brazilian elections.

stories.title: Las elecciones provocan incertidumbre sobre la cúpula de Telefónica

en.title: Elections create uncertainty over Telefónica leadership
en.summary: Electoral developments are generating uncertainty regarding the leadership structure at Telefónica.

stories.title: Unicaja eleva al 2,55% la remuneración de su cuenta digital

en.title: Unicaja raises digital account remuneration to 2.55%
en.summary: Unicaja has increased the interest rate on its digital account to 2.55% as an offer for new customers.
